baton.allergenInfo: Allergen Warning Contains gluten, egg, and dairy products. May contain traces of tree nuts (hazelnuts, pistachios, walnuts, almonds), soy, and sesame as they are processed on the same production line.
baton.servingSuggestion: To fully experience its exquisite flavor and texture, it is recommended to let it rest at room temperature for 10-15 minutes before consumption.
baton.storage: Store in the refrigerator between +4° and +6°C. Protect from direct sunlight and do not keep at room temperature for long periods.
baton.longTermStorage: Storage Store in a -18° deep freezer. Preparation Thaw in the refrigerator at +4° for 8-12 hours before consumption. Warning Do not refreeze thawed products. Consume within 3 days after thawing by keeping in the refrigerator.
